You might have heard about a new virus making headlines—Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV). While it's not new (first identified in 2001)... https://t.co/ATuxgdoPpQ

nodes.author: icodehelthya
nodes.text:
there's been a recent uptick in cases, especially in China. 

➡️ What You Need to Know:

Symptoms: presents flu-like symptoms: cough, fever, and nasal congestion.

Transmission: Spread through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes.

nodes.author: icodehelthya
nodes.text:
Risk Groups: Young children, the elderly, and those with weakened immune systems.

➡️ Protection Tips

✅ Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water for at least 20 seconds.
✅ Cover your mouth and nose with a tissue or your elbow when coughing or sneezing.

nodes.author: icodehelthya
nodes.text:
Remember how COVID-19 changed everything? We had to adapt and protect ourselves. 

Well, even though HMPV might not be as crazy as COVID, it still deserves our attention. Let’s stay sharp, stay clean, and stay safe.
